title: fix(components): pin `source(none)` on the root stylesheet entry so prose stops compiling into the published sheet
body:
Fixes #9569

`packages/components/src/index.css` opened with a bare `@import 'tailwindcss';` — the only one of this repo's four stylesheet entries without a `source(none)` pin. It now reads `@import 'tailwindcss' source(none);`, keeping the FULL Tailwind import because this is the root sheet: preflight, the `@theme` block and the base layer still emit exactly as before.

## The card's mechanism sentence is falsified, and the PM had already measured it

The card asks for "the `source(none)` pin its three siblings carry (`@import 'tailwindcss' source(none);` … mirroring `fields`)". The siblings carry no such thing. `packages/fields/src/index.css` states verbatim *"This file has no `@import 'tailwindcss'` on purpose"*; what `fields`, `plugin-grid` and `plugin-kanban` carry is `@reference` on components' entry plus a utilities-only `@import 'tailwindcss/utilities.css' layer(utilities) source(none);`. Mirroring them literally would have dropped preflight and the shared theme from the only sheet that ships them. The PM seat flagged this before dispatch and the landed spelling is the one it proposed; I verified it is legal Tailwind v4 and that preflight and the theme survive it.

## Three things measured rather than assumed

**1. The `@source` lines actually fire.** This was the highest-risk failure mode: once detection is off, those lines are the only thing keeping the sheet non-empty, and a near-empty sheet builds just as green as a correct one. `packages/runner/src/index.css` records five `@source` lines that were each wrong by one `src` segment and contributed nothing. Two legs, both restoring from `HEAD` with the restore proven by blob hash:

- *Ablation* — deleting `@source '../src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'` collapses the compilation from 158,345 bytes / 1289 classes to 9,694 bytes / 4 classes. The line is load-bearing.
- *Absolute-path probe* — rewriting all three `@source` paths to absolute and moving the compile base to the package root produces a **byte-identical** sheet. So the relative spelling lands exactly on `packages/components/src`, and `base` governs only the automatic root, never the `@source` lines.

**2. Detection roots at the PROCESS CWD, not at `packages/components/`.** The card says the latter; `fields` and `runner` say the former, and they are right. Same commit, same command: 1312 classes / 161,225 bytes with the cwd at the package, 3303 classes / 439,726 bytes from the repo root. After the pin the compiled sheet is byte-identical from either directory, which it was not before.

**3. Class census re-derived, not quoted.** 1312 → 1289, so exactly 23 leave, and each one traces to a prose file: 12 to `CHANGELOG.md`, 3 to `README.md`, 2 to `README_SHADCN_SYNC.md`, 4 to the JSON examples in the renderer docs, 1 to `shadcn-components.json`, and `invert` to an ordinary English word inside a comment in `tsconfig.test.json`. **Zero of the 23 is emitted by any shipped source under `packages/components/src`**, checked with a matcher that respects Tailwind candidate boundaries — a substring grep scores `disabled:cursor-not-allowed` as a hit for `cursor-not-allowed`, which is a different candidate producing a different rule — and run with three lit positive controls (`bg-background`, `text-muted-foreground`, `w-full` are found in 25, 59 and 59 shipped files).

## MUST_SURVIVE, both legs, on both kinds of injection

Reproducing what `changeset:version` does — appending the changeset body line to `packages/components/CHANGELOG.md` — then running each plugin's own builder with `write: false` against the components sheet compiled from the entry as it stands on each leg:

| injection | leg | components sheet | plugin-kanban |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-muted-foreground/60` (not in MUST_SURVIVE) | BEFORE | 1313 classes, has it | BUILD_OK — and the class is **stripped** from kanban's sheet |
| `text-muted-foreground/60` | AFTER | 1289, absent | BUILD_OK, class **survives** |
| `bg-card/60` (in MUST_SURVIVE) | BEFORE | 1313, has it | **BUILD_THREW** — `The subtraction removed 1 utility(ies) that only this build can produce: .bg-card/60` |
| `bg-card/60` | AFTER | 1289, absent | BUILD_OK, class survives |

All six MUST_SURVIVE entries pass for `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-grid` and `fields` on the AFTER leg.

## Beyond the card: this is already breaking three published packages today

Running the same harness with a **non-Tailwind** injection isolates the fix from the injection, and the plugin sheets still change — the prose contamination is stripping classes from sibling published artifacts on `main` right now, with no `changeset:version` needed. Restored by this PR:

- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` — `h-[600px]`, `sm:px-6`, `sm:py-4`
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` — `bg-blue-50`, `cursor-not-allowed`
- `@object-ui/fields` — `bg-blue-50`, `bg-blue-500`, `bg-gray-50`, `text-white`

Each is emitted by that package's own shipped source (`KanbanImpl.tsx` spells `px-4 sm:px-6`, `FormulaBar.tsx` spells `cursor-not-allowed`, `ImageLightbox.tsx` spells `text-white`), and each was being subtracted out because components' prose-polluted sheet happened to contain it. That is why the changeset names four packages, not one.

## Deviations from the card, all measurement-driven

1. **`minor`, not `patch`.** Removing utilities from a published stylesheet contracts a published artifact. This repo forbids `major` outside the `@objectstack` major-sync release and ships its own breaking changes as `minor` with the break spelled out, which is what the changeset body does.
2. **Four packages named, not one.** The three siblings' published sheets change too, measured above.
3. **The `@source` pin test needed repairing, and gained a leg.** Its docblock asserted the entry "opens with a bare `@import 'tailwindcss'`, so automatic source detection is ON" — a claim this branch falsifies, and it also had `base` backwards. Corrected, and a second test now pins the prose door shut: it asserts `.flex-shrink-0` is absent from the compiled sheet behind a lit control asserting `CHANGELOG.md` still names it. Reverting the entry to its bare import turns that test red (vitest exit 1); it passes on the fix.
4. **One ledger entry.** The new test reads a markdown file, so `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` needs a verdict for it. Adjudicated with what it reads and what the scanner offered that it does not.

`flex-shrink-0` is worth a second look: it is a deprecated Tailwind v3 alias this repo deliberately migrated away from, and it was shipping in the published bundle **solely because the changelog entry announcing that migration names it**. Same for `w-[--sidebar-width]` and the `origin-[--radix-` pair — the changelog entry recording the move to v4 syntax quotes the old spelling, and that quote recreated the v3 classes.

## `changeset-release.yml`

One sentence, next to the claim it qualifies. `THE VERSION STEP CANNOT MOVE A SOURCE BYTE` is the design note that made this defect invisible from the release lane: a generated `CHANGELOG.md` is a Tailwind source input, which is exactly how a changeset body reached `dist/index.css`.

## Gates

Derived by hand from this repo's own `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`, ⛔ not from the dispatch prompt. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives only in `objectstack` and **refuses** to answer for this repo — asserted with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui`, exit 2: *"Gate families are derived from the workflows and check scripts of the tree this process runs in."*

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `check-changeset-presence` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-fixed` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) | 0 |
| `check-control-bytes` | 0 |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | 0 — 0 new citations |
| `check-lint-coverage` | 0 — 46/46 packages, 0 errors |
| `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files | 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` | 0 |
| build of the dependency closure | 0 |
| `@object-ui/components` `type-check` | 0 |
| `vitest run packages/components/` | 0 — 276 files, 2699 tests |
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__` | 0 — 164 files, 4779 tests |

NOT MEASURED, with reasons, ⛔ not read as green: `check-governed-queue-guard` (exit 1, needs `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`; it refuses to exit 0 when it cannot look), `check-required-check-set` (exit 2, HTTP 401 on the branch-rules API), `check-merge-queue-head` (exit 2, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` unset). All three are CI-credentialed patrols, and none reads a path in this diff.

This diff touches **no governed surface** — classified against the guard's own `GOVERNED_SURFACES` export with three lit controls (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/adr/…`, `skills/…` all classify correctly).

## Acceptance notes

- `objectui#8455` covers `packages/runner/src/index.css`, which carries the same bare import: its census names that row explicitly as **published**, and its shape C is a repo-wide gate over exactly this. It genuinely covers it, so this PR does not widen to runner and no duplicate card was filed. Its shape A is this card, and it predicted the removal at 23 rules including `.flex-shrink-0` — which is what was measured here.
- Noted, not filed: `objectui#9569`'s own body cites `plugin-published-stylesheet.test.ts:196/:252` and `KanbanImpl.tsx:492`, cross-file line addresses of the form this repo's `#11` bans. An issue body is not a carrier that rule names, and nothing re-reads it. Successor: none.
- Noted, not filed: `packages/components/src/index.css` spells its scan `@source '../src/**'` where the three siblings spell `'./**'`. Both resolve to the same directory, proven byte-identically above, so this is cosmetic drift, not a defect. Successor: whoever implements `objectui#8455`'s repo-wide gate.
